name: btcticker
description: Real-time BTC price ticker for kiosk display, with Android home-screen widgets via Capacitor

scripts.build:www: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp index.html db.html style.css shared.js app.js www/ && cp -r assets data www/
scripts.build: npm run build:www && rm -rf dist && cp -r www dist
scripts.sync:android: npm run build:www && npx cap sync android
